scope: Preserve literal multiline content.text visually for heading, text, button, and link node types.

verified_defect.reproduction: Published heading with two authored lines returned collapsed innerText ("Címsor első sora Címsor második sora") while Page Model retained the newline.
verified_defect.cause: The shared public renderer CSS applied white-space:pre-wrap to .visual-text but omitted .visual-heading and .visual-button. Inspector and Canvas already used a pre-wrapped plain-text surface.
verified_defect.impact: content.text declares multiline:true for heading, text, button, and link; the public page did not visually honor the contract for heading and URL-backed button/link types.

implementation.change: Shared public renderer style now applies white-space:pre-wrap to .visual-heading and .visual-button.
implementation.dependencies: No dependency added; native CSS white-space behavior.

acceptance.assertions: Exact visible innerText and computed pre-wrap at Canvas and public output; command route; Undo/Redo; draft Save/reload isolation; explicit Publish parity.
